mapper.sql: stat_id, bs_type,os_type, entrance_id, c2s_pkt_num, s2c_pkt_num, c2s_byte_len, s2c_byte_len, stat_time
mapper.select: SELECT os_type osType, count(os_type) count ,(SUM(c2s_pkt_num)+SUM(s2c_pkt_num)) pktNum,(SUM(c2s_byte_len)+SUM(s2c_byte_len)) byteLen FROM galaxy.traffic_ua_statistic WHERE os_type !=0 and stat_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 555 HOUR) GROUP BY os_type ORDER BY count DESC limit 0,10
